title: Off-diagonal unit cocycle normalization on projective space
statement: Let k be a field, r>=3, and let t_ij be units on the standard-cover overlaps of projective r-1-space satisfying the triple-overlap cocycle equation. There exist an integer d and chart units a_i such that the normalization equation holds for every pair of distinct indices i != j.

proof.text: On each pairwise distinct overlap identify the section ring with the Laurent polynomial ring in the coordinate ratio and the remaining affine coordinates. Degree comparison in the remaining variables forces a unit to be a scalar times one Laurent monomial. Comparing the two independent Laurent exponents on triple overlaps gives one common exponent and a scalar coboundary; choosing a base chart supplies the constants a_i.
